is_english.description: true if a real English word, fixed phrase or widely used abbreviation

headword.description: dictionary headword (lemma) to store it under, lower-case unless an acronym or proper noun; copy the input lower-cased when is_english is false

form_note_zh.description: Chinese note when the input differs from the headword, e.g. 'go 的过去式'; else empty

phonetic.description: IPA for the headword like /əˈbændən/, or empty

pos.description: part(s) of speech like 'v.' or 'n./v.', or empty

meaning_zh.description: common senses in Simplified Chinese, at most 80 characters, empty when not English

definition_en.description: one short English definition, empty when not English

suggested_correction.description: if the input looks like a misspelling of a common word, that word; else empty

safe_for_sharing.description: false if the string is a personal name, offensive, private or otherwise unsuitable to show other users

note_zh.description: short Chinese explanation when is_english is false or a correction is suggested; else empty
